column1: # German texts of the recipe matrix-hook (English text <TAB> translation; the shared helpers' texts are in the core catalog)
Enable: Request Approved and Request Automatically Approved.
column2: Einschalten: Request Approved und Request Automatically Approved.

column1: The room for the messages is read-only for you (you can still delete and react).
column2: Der Raum mit den Meldungen ist für dich nur lesbar (Löschen und Reagieren geht weiter).

column1: Triggers: On Grab, On Import, On Upgrade, On Health Issue, On Health Restored. Test sends a message.
column2: Triggers: On Grab, On Import, On Upgrade, On Health Issue, On Health Restored. Test schickt eine Nachricht.

column1: 1. Radarr and Sonarr: Settings -> Connect -> + -> Webhook, Method POST, the address above.
column2: 1. Radarr und Sonarr: Settings -> Connect -> + -> Webhook, Method POST, die Adresse oben.

column1: 2. Seerr: Settings -> Notifications -> Webhook, Webhook URL = the address above, keep the JSON payload as it is.
column2: 2. Seerr: Settings -> Notifications -> Webhook, Webhook URL = die Adresse oben, die JSON-Payload so lassen.

column1: 3. Accept the second invitation too, the chat 'Homeserver bot', and type  help  there: the commands (clear, status, test, mute) work in it for your Matrix ID only.
column2: 3. Auch die zweite Einladung annehmen, den Chat 'Homeserver bot', und dort  help  eintippen: Die Befehle (clear, status, test, mute) gelten darin nur für deine Matrix-ID.

column1: Maintainerr (Script) and SABnzbd need no click: their helpers got this address (hs recipe arr / sabnzbd run again if they were installed before).
